candidates.budget_accounting: Parallel group cost is sum(estimated_cost_secs) across the selected candidates.
candidates.code_hint:
COMBINATION JUMP: make a substantive, coordinated change in EACH selected direction. 嵌入表征: Item embedding dimensions, parameterization, tying and embedding normalization. Keep feature definitions, interaction/scoring mechanism, GRU topology, history policy, loss and optimizer fixed.
序列建模: Causal input context length, truncation and ordering/position representation. Preserve input feature definitions, embedding design, GRU topology, interest readout, loss and optimizer. Never introduce future interactions or change supplied splits.
Only minimal shape/checkpoint/predictor consistency edits outside the chosen directions are allowed; they must not introduce another modeling or training change.
